run_cleanup_dataset: run the cleanup_dataset script to filter an OpenWebText JSONL corpus by language and document length
run_filter_corpus: run filter_corpus on a JSONL file to remove non-English and short documents and write cleaned output
create_dataset_filter: create a dataset filter that fixes text encoding, detects non-English documents, and skips short documents
refactor_filter_corpus: refactor filter_corpus to use a configurable minimum token length threshold instead of the hardcoded 128
review_print_progress: review the print_progress function to add percentage completion and documents-per-second metrics
